rules: One high-level command may fan out into multiple checked outputs inside the same project.
Each requested output is represented as a child checklist item rather than a separate user command.
Different output types and configured variants may run in parallel when they do not share a conflicting resource.
At most one active task per project + outputType + variantId key by default.
Parent command is not complete until every required child has a verified saved result or an explicit terminal failure/hold with evidence.
A claimed child must show START/RUNNING evidence within 60 seconds or enter immediate handoff diagnosis.
Audio/video jobs use media-duration-aware budgets and file-progress evidence after START.
If tasks compete for the same dedicated Chrome tab/session, GPU renderer, download target, or output filename, serialize only that shared resource instead of the whole project.
NotebookLM Studio outputs and Flow scene/variant generation are treated as fanout children under the same parent command when they belong to one content project.
evidenceNote: NotebookLM officially supports background Audio Overview generation while other artifacts are generated, multiple outputs of the same type in one notebook, and Studio multitasking. Flow supports controlled scene generation using Ingredients, Frames, Extend and SceneBuilder-style workflows. Backend simultaneous guarantees can vary, so actual START/progress/readback evidence remains authoritative.
